items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, somebody told us, I know Kid Clayton told me they worked over there.

ctx.x: Well I stayed, I stayed in that band until we cut the band on to 19 pieces at that time. Now we used to rehearse over at the Tulane's Club, and we used to rehearse a lot here on, about the Fifth Ward Club out here on Dumaine Street.
Yeah, somebody told us, I know Kid Clayton told me they worked over there. I never knew that.
Yeah, just on Dumaine near Charter Street. Near Charter, is that what even? Between Charter and Decatur.
